description: Returns one RoleWeek role by its slug (as returned by search_jobs, or the last part of a roleweek.com/job/<slug>/ URL): employer, location and work mode, level, pay as listed, posted date, the date it leaves RoleWeek, skills mentioned, an excerpt of the employer's description, and the role's RoleWeek URL, whose page links to the employer's own application page.

slug.description: Job slug, e.g. 'senior-backend-engineer-stripe-seattle-1a2b3c4d', or a roleweek.com/job/<slug>/ URL.

name: get_job
title: Get a RoleWeek job
